goal:
A PR may only be opened for a candidate whose gates the SERVER evaluated and stored as all PASS (README: verified PR; D-006).
1. services/api/main.py /v1/gates/evaluate must store the evaluated diff and tests together with the gates in its evidence
   record (keys "diff", "tests", "gates"); response unchanged ("gates", "evidence_id").
2. POST /v1/pr/create request becomes {evidence_id: str, title: str, body: str = "", branch: str = "", base: str = "main"}.
   Any client-supplied "diff" or "gates" fields are ignored (never trusted).
   - unknown evidence_id -> 404
   - evidence record without both "diff" and "gates" (e.g. an objective record) -> 409
   - any stored gate whose result != "PASS" -> 409, detail names the failing gate(s)
   - otherwise call create_pr resolved from module evoforge.github AT CALL TIME with the STORED diff; the PR body is the client
     body + one line per stored gate "<GATE>=<RESULT> (<reason>)" + a line "Evidence: <evidence_id>".
   - RuntimeError from create_pr -> 400 (as today); evoforge.patch.PatchError -> 409.
   - response: {"pr": <create_pr result>, "evidence_id": <new evidence id>, "source_evidence_id": <evidence_id>}; the new
     evidence record stores "source_evidence_id" and the PR html_url.
Nothing else changes.
